blocks.tamil_translation: in the last times, standing firm upon the laws of Din and doing deeds will be like holding a live coal. Very soon a day is coming; in those days, for those who do deeds, the reward that is gained when fifty people do a deed will be given for one deed of theirs,” the Prophet ﷺ said. Hazrat Abu Tha'labah (RA) says, “When I asked, “O Rasulullah, the reward of fifty of them?” (or the reward of fifty of us? For the reward of the deeds of the Sahabah (RA) is immense), the Prophet ﷺ said, “One man among them will receive the reward of fifty people among you.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- This does not mean that the person who does deeds in the last times will, by this special virtue, rise in rank above the Sahabah, because the excellence of the Sahabah is higher than that of the rest of the Ummah. From this hadith it becomes known that enjoining good and forbidding evil is necessary, but that if a time comes when the capacity to accept the truth has completely disappeared, the command is to stay apart and do deeds. By the great grace of Allah Ta'ala, such a time has not yet come, because in this time the Ummah has the capacity to accept the truth.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ نِ الْخُدْرِيِّ ﵁ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْجُلُوسَ بِالطُّرُقَاتِ فَقَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ! مَا لَنَا مِنْ مَجَالِسِنَا بُدٌّ نَتَحَدَّثُ فِيهَا، فَقَالَ: فَإِذَا أَبَيْتُمْ إِلَّا الْمَجْلِسَ فَأَعْطُوا الطَّرِيقَ حَقَّهُ قَالُوا: وَمَا حَقُّ الطَّرِيقِ يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ؟ قَالَ: غَضُّ الْبَصَرِ، وَكَفُّ اْلاَذَي، وَرَدُّ السَّلَامِ، وَاْلاَمْرُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ، وَالنَّهْيُ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب قول الله تعالي يا ايها الذين امنوا لا تدخلوا بيوتا....، رقم:٦٢٢٩
